notes:
v1.2.2 — bracket chart shows all live positions, not just state-tracked ones.

The v1.2.1 filter dropped brackets whose underlying position no longer existed on Alpaca (correct, e.g. after a manual liquidation). But it also dropped positions present on Alpaca that the bot's open_brackets state didn't know about (e.g. ARM in your last screenshot — alive on Alpaca but the bot's rearm cycle hadn't yet registered it). The chart said 'No open brackets' while the POSITION MANAGEMENT table below was clearly showing the position.

Now the gauge iterates LIVE positions and picks bracket levels in this order:
  1. Bot's open_brackets state (real Alpaca TP/SL orders)
  2. ATR-derived levels from yfinance (per-stock 14-day ATR × user's stop / TP multipliers)
  3. Fallback ±2.5 % bands

Positions that exist on Alpaca always show up on the chart, even if the bot hasn't synced their bracket yet.
